author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Welcome to Open Bar Episode 181, dear viewer! Tonight we'll be talking about reports of Marvel paying influencers to hype Avengers Doomsday, the dramas and madness surrounding Pragmata, and the Savant TV show finally getting released after being shelved last year. We'll also be reviewing the trailers for Clayface and Ladies First.

title: Open Bar #181 - Marvel Buying Hype, Pragmata Drama, The Savant Cometh

author: The Critical Drinker
description: In the first episode of a new series I'm trying out, we'll look at some hilariously bad casting choices that either tanked good movies, or made a bad situation even worse. And in our inaugural class, we've got some truly special entries - Gal Gadot, Mark Wahlberg, Bella Ramsey, Phoebe Waller-Bridge and George Clooney.
title: Casting Calamities - Phoebe Waller-Bridge, Mark Wahlberg, Bella Ramsey, Gal Gadot, George Clooney
